detail:
Wrote docs/adr/2026-09-foundation-contracts.appendix-b-oracle-rulings.md.

BLOCKING DISCOVERY: the oracles' OPEN QUESTIONS sections do not exist in test/acceptance/oracles/*.oracle.md or *.fixtures.json. Only six ids survive as cross-references: C09 OQ-1, OQ-5, OQ-8; C11 OQ-2; C16 Q5, Q6. Verified not a truncation: each working-tree oracle file is byte-identical to its staged git blob (sha1 of "blob <len>\0<content>" matches the index entry); no other copy exists under ~/.claude/projects, tasks/teams/sessions/file-history, or the scratchpad. The 56 counted in the programme log (D14) came from the authoring subagents' final reports, which were never written into the files. The lead can paste them into the appendix §10 template; every ruling is keyed for mapping.

RULINGS: 73 rows — 54 oracle defaults stand, 12 adjusted with ADR reason, 7 LEAD DECISION NEEDED. Coverage: 8 cross-cutting (evidence-class + delivery-state vocabulary mappings, how the harness can mint human_ruling at all given the TTY-only ceremony, admission-order that decides which refusal name applies, membership must be seeded as events, scopeMatches vs scopeGoverns), C09 12, C10 12, C11 13, C14 15, C16 13. The C11 rule_A..rule_E table is mapped onto ADR §4.3 precedence steps (rule_C and rule_E adjusted; both adjustments leave C11's expected outcomes unchanged).

LEAD DECISIONS (7): attachment size policy (ADR §13 unresolved, C09 A14/A16 depend on it); C09 OQ-8 scoring split; C10 admission_trigger field; C10 uncertainty-window retention; C10 cross-case scoring overlap (C24/C18); C14 source-observer scope; and the only case-blocking one — C14-D11: the ADR has no lifecycle kind for reinstating a SUPERSEDED record, and §4.4 says the opposite ("a restored superseded stays superseded") while C14's positive control P1 requires ev-020 to succeed. Proposed: a distinct `reinstated` kind requiring `rule` capability, leaving §4.4 untouched for archive-restores that C16 depends on.

CONFLICTS (6 + 1 ADR-internal): (1) §4.3.1 "a lower-class successor becomes contested and is shown beside the governing record" vs C11 A05 "never appears in any current() result" / C09 A12 conflict_state == none; (2) §4.1 `promoted` (provisional -> active) vs C16's "cannot promote provisional data" — status vs class collision; (3) exact event-count invariants (C09 count==8, C10 events_total==5, C11 7 pairs, C14 15 ids) vs ADR §1.3 making principal/membership/observation/receipt events too — a correct v3 store fails these counts; (4) C14 P1 restore-of-superseded vs §4.4; (5) C14's store-inside-the-rewound-worktree vs §8.2 exchange ref + R09 non-interference (the trigger cannot fire under the default carrier — run both arms); (6) C14 `representations[]` on the envelope vs the strict envelope — move to the receipt/admission projection. Plus ADR-internal: §2.2/§2.3 as written let no automated harness produce a human_ruling; the contracts decision's signed-import path resolves it but is not in the ADR body.
summary: Appendix B written: 73 oracle ruling rows (54 stand / 12 adjusted / 7 lead-needed) + 6 oracle-vs-ADR conflicts; BUT the 56 OPEN QUESTIONS sections are NOT in the repo — only 6 ids recoverable
